Martin and Ramirez Traded
<Texas:team#28> and <Milwaukee:team#16> announced some roster changes today as the Rangers acquired 24-year old minor league RHP <Stiven Cruz:player#46531> and 17-year old minor league 3B <Osiris Ramirez:player#140908> from the Brewers in exchange for 40-year old RHP <Chris Martin:player#32183>. Representatives from both teams say they are pleased with the deal.

Texas will retain a portion of Martin's remaining contract. 

This year, <Martin:player#32183> has made 20 relief appearances with no saves. In 21 innings, he has fanned 23 hitters and recorded 1 win and 2 losses with a 3.00 ERA.
